desc: Ideate threshold/marginal-cost approach and identify pitfalls.
Implement complete Python solution with binary search over marginal-cost threshold C.
Use a safe upper bound for C (e.g., max(max(P), 2*isqrt(M*max(P))+2)) and handle cases where no unit is affordable.
Validate the threshold-to-count formula and final remainder adjustment count + (M-cost)//(C+1).
Test edge cases: answer 0, N=1, very large M, all P_i large, and performance for N=2e5.
